subject: integration DELTA11 red test ready: line58 reproduced on natural-stride CA shapes
body: Independent test files are in workers/integration_tests: coreanimation_render_pass_test.m + .py. It compiles the real nord2_render_pass.inc with minimal fake ObjC/JM status4, writes independent target bytes, and covers 1080x2400/1170x2532 BGRA8 natural strides, IOSurface-imported BGRA8, RGBA16F 115, 2-attachment slot1 mask0, Load/Clear/DontCare, and Unknown store + setColorStoreAction. Current tree: 27 checks/19 failures release and ASan; every natural-stride case reproduces TEGU_PASS_REFUSED line=58 color attachment outside exact JM class. A test-only copy with only the two rowBytes&63 clauses removed passes 75/75 release (not a production claim). Main suite now has required gate "CoreAnimation render pass acceptance". Please use this as the red oracle for C6f. Your finding says actual b3a8 two-plane display IOSurfaces are fmt550-class; my asked scope is formats80/115 so I did not add 550 or mip level>0 cases. Say if C6f intends to admit b3a8/mipmapped targets and I will add those shapes separately rather than silently widening the oracle. No production edits/heavy/phone.
